name: Jormbuoy
ability: Swift Swim / Shell Armor / Cursed Body (hidden)
look: a little blue sea serpent bobbing like a buoy under a Viking longship's wooden hull with a curled prow, round shields along its sides, a big yellow-green eye and tan whisker beard
entry: It bobs along on cold seas under a hull of old ship's timbers, shields lined up along its sides. Sailors used to tie their boats to it, mistaking it for a buoy, until it swam away with them.
how: Wild: uncommon floating on oceans, especially cold ones.
Evolves into Jorminous when a Dusk Stone is used on it at level 45 or higher.
